title: CAGE-2 Scenario2 defence task
description: Evaluate a selected blue policy against one declared CAGE-2 red variant on the packaged full Scenario2 topology.

evaluation_protocol.intent: Retain the source-projected blue reward as bounded portable evidence without exporting native state.

cage2-cumulative-blue-reward.name: Cumulative blue reward
cage2-cumulative-blue-reward.measured_construct: Sum of admitted source reward components projected for the blue participant.

intended_use: Exercise the installed full-Scenario2 apparatus in one episode or the declared two-seed study.
non_use: Do not treat this apparatus check as an outcome-equivalence benchmark or replication result.
population_or_construct: The fixed three-subnet, thirteen-host Scenario2 case under the qualified CAGE-2 source mapping.

split_and_leakage_controls.partitioning_strategy: Fixed public source-projected topology; hidden native truth is never exported.

notes: Requires the separately installed qualified CybORG source and the cyborg-cage2 backend.

validity_notes.note: The fixed selected Scenario2 supports apparatus validation, not broad empirical claims.
